boundary: Selected context only; no source execution, novelty, canonical, or independent-reproduction credit transfers.

records.selected_lesson: Use explicit species or field ordering rather than mapping insertion order; symbolic reaction arithmetic is not real chemistry.
Validate semantics rather than prose capitalization and isolate only a failed canonical dependency.
Defensive copies keep a candidate from mutating its oracle; labels must match actual operation scope.
Preserve failed canonical cardinality checks and direct-child corrections without converting earlier failures into success.
Finite language conclusions require declared states, alphabet, and complete transition domain.
Bound regex and NFA comparisons by exact length and engine; do not claim unbounded equivalence.
A newer direct hold can supersede earlier route permission prospectively while preserving the earlier record.
Bind raw Git bytes separately from checkout bytes and state stochastic or thermodynamic assumptions with every result.
Use the weighted 45-position route, both-session candidates, ten-source window, ordinary three-package default, and one-shot canonical.
Use source-faithful v689 routing, explicit Git-blob domains, both-session portfolios, retained failures, and one-shot owner-scoped canonical validation.
